title: DUP: Detection-guided Unlearning for Backdoor Purification in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2508.01647v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As backdoor attacks become more stealthy and robust, they reveal critical weaknesses in current defense strategies: detection methods often rely on coarse-grained feature statistics, and purification methods typically require full retraining or additional clean models. To address these challenges, we propose DUP (Detection-guided Unlearning for Purification), a unified framework that integrates backdoor detection with unlearning-based purification. The detector captures feature-level anomalies by jointly leveraging class-agnostic distances and inter-layer transitions. These deviations are integrated through a weighted scheme to identify poisoned inputs, enabling more fine-grained analysis. Based on the detection results, we purify the model through a parameter-efficient unlearning mechanism that avoids full retraining and does not require any external clean model. translated_title: DUP：面向语言模型后门净化的检测引导遗忘方法
translated_abstract: 随着后门攻击变得更加隐蔽和鲁棒，它们暴露了当前防御策略的关键弱点：检测方法通常依赖于粗粒度的特征统计，而净化方法通常需要完整的重新训练或额外的干净模型。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了DUP（检测引导的遗忘净化），这是一个将后门检测与基于遗忘的净化相结合的统一框架。该检测器通过联合利用类无关距离和层间转换来捕获特征级别的异常。这些偏差通过加权方案进行整合以识别被投毒的输入，从而实现更细粒度的分析。基于检测结果，我们通过一种参数高效的遗忘机制来净化模型，该机制避免了完整的重新训练，且不需要任何外部干净模型。具体而言，我们创新性地将知识蒸馏重新用于
tldr: 提出DUP统一框架，通过联合类无关距离与层间转换实现细粒度后门检测，并利用参数高效的遗忘机制净化语言模型中的后门，无需完整重训练或外部干净模型。
en_tdlr: DUP is a unified framework that integrates fine-grained backdoor detection (leveraging class-agnostic distances and inter-layer transitions) with a parameter-efficient unlearning mechanism to purify backdoored language models without full retraining or external clean models.
